column3: The Hebrew says “who made it”; NASB has “who made the earth,” following the LXX.
“Well-being and faithfulness” is rendered “peace and truth.”
“Turn back the captivity” is rendered “restore the fortunes.”
“Turn back the captivity” is rendered “restore the fortunes.”
“A branch of righteousness” is rendered “a righteous Branch of David.”
“Which anyone will call it” is rendered “the name by which she shall be called”; NASB supplies “the name.”
“The priests the Levites” is rendered “the Levitical priests.”
“The Levites the priests” is rendered “the Levitical priests.”
“Turn back their captivity” is rendered “restore their fortunes.”
